data.name: Gualterio
data.gender_notes: Gualterio is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin 'Gualterius', derived from 'waltra' meaning 'rule' and 'ger' meaning 'strong'. A name for a strong and powerful leader. The name Gualterio carries the meaning “Strong rule, leader” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Gualterio usually hope their child will grow to embody strong rule, leader and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes strength and leadership in faith.
data.etymology: Gualterio belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Strong rule, leader.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Gualterio total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_hebrew.name: גואלטריו
in_hebrew.meaning: בן המלך - נצר - עצמאות - גבורה - תורה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: גואלטריו (Gualterio) הוא שם עברי שמקורו בלטיני. משמעותו: בן המלך, נצר, עצמאות, גבורה, תורה. השם נגזר מהמילה ברבח (galut) שפירושה 'גלות'. השם נחשב כשם נאמן ואמין במסורת היהודית. שול ילרל אררון יריל יאל יורו יאורי.

in_greek.name: Γουαλτέριο
in_greek.meaning: υιός τοῦ βασιλέως - νεκρός - αὐτονομία - δύναμις - νόμος
in_greek.long_meaning: Γουαλτέριο (Gualterio) είναι ονομασία που προέρχεται από τη λατινική γλώσσα. Η σημασία του: υιός τού βασιλέως, νεκρός, αυτονομία, δύναμις, νόμος. Το όνομα προέρχεται από την λέξη κπλύτεσ (galutá) που σημαίνει 'εγκατάλειψη'. Το όνομα θεωρείται ως ειλικρινές και αξιοπίστευτο στην ελληνική παράδοση.

in_latin.name: Gualterio
in_latin.meaning: filius regis - mortuus - libertas - virtus - lex
in_latin.long_meaning: Gualterio est nomen quod a lingua Latina orta est. Significatio eius: filius regis, mortuus, libertas, virtus, lex. Nomen a verbo éxigo éxigo éxigo éxigo (galut) ortum est, quod significat 'exsulatio'. Nomen fidelitas et fiducia in ecclesia Christi habet.

in_english.name: Gualterio
in_english.meaning: son of the king - protector - independence - bravery - law
in_english.long_meaning: Gualterio is a Christian name with Latin roots. Meaning: son of the king, protector, independence, bravery, law. Gualterio is considered a faithful and trustworthy name in Christian tradition, associated with qualities of protection, freedom, and moral strength.
